title: Onboarding
description: Four intro pages whose art, title and body slide at different speeds while the background and button blend from one page color to the next.
steps: Pages are full width with `loop={false}`; in each page the art lags by `relativeProgress` × `0.4` of a page while the title and body lead by `0.25` and `0.45` and fade.
The `progress` shared value blends the background and button colors with `interpolateColor` and fades out Skip on the last page.
Next calls `next()` and Skip calls `scrollTo({ index: 3 })`; `autoplay` turns a page every `2800` ms, and on the last page the demo waits one interval and calls `scrollTo({ index: 0 })`.
